|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | percent (1-100) or amount (minor units, subscription currency) One of `percent`, `amount`. |
| `value` | `number` | **yes** | Percent 1-100, or a positive integer amount in minor units |
| `duration` | `string` | **yes** | one_time consumes on the next invoice; forever persists until removed One of `one_time`, `forever`. |
| `note` | `string` | no | Optional operator note |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `discount`. One of `discount`. |
| `id` | `string` | The discount id. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `source` | `string` | Present and `manual` for a discount without a coupon. One of `manual`. |
| `status` | `string` | The discount state. |
| `remaining_periods` | `integer` | Billing periods that the discount still covers. Null if it has no end. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Manual discount applied |
| `400` | Invalid value, wrong subscription status, or a discount already exists |
| `404` | No such subscription |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |
